description: A vendor-neutral standard and SDK that collects traces, metrics and logs from .NET's built-in APIs and exports them to any backend.
The OpenTelemetry wire protocol; `UseOtlpExporter()` sends every signal to the endpoint in `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`.
The .NET tracing API: a source creates activities (spans), and `StartActivity` returns `null` when no listener such as `AddSource` is registered.
The .NET metrics API that creates counters and histograms, collected by OpenTelemetry once registered with `AddMeter`.
Carrying the trace id and parent span id across a process boundary, automatic for HTTP via `traceparent` and explicit inject/extract for broker messages.
Health check endpoints where liveness runs no dependency checks and readiness checks dependencies such as the database, returning 503 when unhealthy.
The OpenTelemetry description of the emitting service, such as `service.name`, attached to every span, metric and log.
